newsitem.title: USA: Digi says CEO Ervin Kamm resigns.
newsitem.headline: Digi says CEO Ervin Kamm resigns.

text.p: Digi International Inc said president and chief executive Ervin Kamm resigned and vice president Jerry Dusa was appointed interim acting chief executive, effective immediately.

The company said the board of directors will conduct a search for Kamm's permanent successor. Chairman John Schinas said "We appreciate Erv's years of service and his contributions to the company. We wish him the best in his future endeavors."
Further details about Kamm's resignation were not immediately available. Digi is a computer company.
